mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 1% signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods when FEDFUNDS < 1%, or the rate decline is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 8.5% triggers a weakening labor market, reducing consumer spending and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3 percentage points in a single month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive despite UNRATE crossing the 8.5% threshold, or the rate increase is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: When demand growth (GDPC1) outpaces supply growth (INDPRO) by over 2% in a month, it signals an expansionary economic cycle, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > INDPRO growth by >2% in a month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite the demand-supply gap exceeding 2%, or the growth difference is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained drop in the federal funds rate below 1% intensifies monetary easing, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns fail to rise significantly (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS < 1% in the late-cycle regime, or the regime is not active.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in employment (PAYEMS) of over 5% signals labor market stress, reducing consumer confidence and driving negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS drops >5% in a single month
failure_condition: 5-day returns are positive despite the employment drop exceeding 5%, or the decline is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in the federal funds rate and demand growth (GDPC1) create a dual easing signal, strengthening equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls >0.5% and GDPC1 rises >1% in a month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite the combined easing signals, or the rate and growth movements are not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime, a sharp rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 9.5% indicates weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises >0.5 percentage points in a month and monetary tightening regime
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive despite UNRATE rising >0.5% in the tightening regime, or the regime is not active.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) above 94.5 indicates robust supply growth, boosting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns fail to rise significantly (p > 0.05) despite INDPRO trending upward, or the trend is not sustained.
